selected_process_card.title: Banter To Belonging
selected_process_card.why: The strongest route starts as a sendable daily-life joke, escalates with concrete behavior, then turns into belonging through mutual alibi instead of perfect-husband rescue.

routes.title: Parcel Alibi
routes.universal_truth: Some couples do not receive parcels. They give statements.
routes.proof_engine: necessary box -> for-work box -> doorbell again -> both freeze -> boxes hidden together
routes.zuv_role: He is guilty too and becomes co-conspirator, not judge or caretaker.

routes.title: Charger Custody Case
routes.universal_truth: Some marriages run on one charger and two allegations.
routes.proof_engine: bedside charger migration -> low-battery accusation -> cable tug-of-war -> overnight compromise
routes.zuv_role: He argues and compromises in the bit instead of silently fixing it.

routes.title: Grocery Cart Witness
routes.universal_truth: Some couples go for two things and come back with evidence.
routes.proof_engine: two-item promise -> both add nonsense -> bill shock -> mutual silence
routes.zuv_role: He contributes his own unnecessary item, keeping the guilt mutual.

routes.title: Alarm Snooze Conspiracy
routes.universal_truth: Some couples do not wake each other up. They protect the snooze.
routes.proof_engine: alarm rings -> one silences -> both pretend not to know -> late panic
routes.zuv_role: He participates in the lazy conspiracy, but the visual variety is thin.

routes.title: Family Group Chat Translator
routes.universal_truth: Some people marry you. Some slowly learn your family group chat.
routes.proof_engine: one cryptic family message -> her face changes -> he reads room -> silent support
routes.zuv_role: He learns cultural context, but it needs a real phrase to avoid private-context risk.

routes.title: Temperature Treaty
routes.universal_truth: Some couples sleep in two climates.
routes.proof_engine: AC remote -> blanket theft -> fan negotiation -> morning evidence
routes.zuv_role: He negotiates, but it is too close to the rejected blanket lane.

routes.title: Cart Screenshot Courtroom
routes.universal_truth: Some couples do not ask permission. They submit screenshots.
routes.proof_engine: phone screenshots -> approvals -> counter-screenshot -> mutual guilty scroll
routes.zuv_role: He counters with his own cart, but phone UI makes the visuals too text-led.
